setup_outcome: Success using the preinstalled verified public Routeval 0.1.1 wheel offline; no installation or extra dependencies needed.
first_difficulty: Trial README/docs were beneath routeval-agent-trials rather than the workspace root; corrected after initial missing-file errors.
assumptions: Trusted reference per-ID labels and contract are authoritative for this saved-case exercise.
Declared synthetic costs are whole-decision costs under the fixed cost basis, without independent billing authentication.
Callable latencies are saved synthetic callable measurements; no production queue/service latency claim.
failures: Initial documentation lookup returned missing-file errors; preserved in setup-discovery.md.

Initial evidence labelled shared-null escalation recall as pass and used reconstructed baseline numbers; corrected to unavailable/skipped and recorded-decimal comparison. Original outputs preserved in attempt-1/.
requested_improvement: Provide a public structured compare result API or --output JSON with validation diagnostics and watched-metric results. Native comparison is useful but owner critical-cohort, latency and protected-target checks still need application code.

timing.measurement_method: System UTC wall-clock subtraction. Start is first tool shell date output (one-second resolution); stop is artifact-finalization timestamp. No installation time included; not monotonic timing.

assistance: Task assignment and offline verified-wheel installation only; no author coaching, human implementation help, subagents, providers or network.
discovery: Installed metadata README, documented CLI help and public signatures/docstrings only; no implementation inspection or private source imports.
